summary: @servicetitan/form preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 728KB payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~728KB single-line bundle with an obfuscator.io-style rotating string-array loader (function WV8StW shuffles a large constant array n7gIxM) and no counterpart in src/. The advertised purpose of the package is React form components; the shipped bundle is unrelated to that purpose and its logic is concealed from static review. The preinstall hook fires automatically on npm install, so installing this version runs the obfuscated bundle under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on every installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
